name: Taj Mahal
scaleNote: 1 stud per metre. The plinth is 95.5 m square and the dome 23 m tall; both read at one stud to the metre.

plinth.source: Wikipedia, Taj Mahal: '95.5 metres (313 ft) in length' on each side of the square base.

domeHeight.source: Wikipedia, Taj Mahal: '23-metre (75 ft) high marble dome'.

domeDiameter.source: Wikipedia, Taj Mahal: 'inner diameter of 18.4 metres (60 ft)' for the cylindrical drum supporting it.

finialHeight.source: Wikipedia, Taj Mahal: '9.6-metre (31 ft) high gilded finial'.

minaretHeight.source: Wikipedia, Taj Mahal: minarets 'more than 40 metres (130 ft) tall'.

note: The dome is a `Dome` with its own cited height -- 23 m over an 18.4 m drum, which is taller than a hemisphere and is exactly why `Dome` gained a height parameter at Jelling. Four minarets at the plinth's corners. The mausoleum block under the dome is uncited: no source read here gives its footprint.
